app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Get a paginated list of users from Active Directory with optional filtering and group membership criteria. Useful for reporting and bulk operations.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 從 Active Directory 取得使用者的分頁清單，包含選填的篩選與群組成員資格條件。適用於報表與批次作業。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Optional group identifier to filter users who are members of a specific group. When specified, only users belonging to this group will be returned.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 可選的群組識別碼，用於篩選特定群組成員的使用者。指定時，僅會傳回屬於此群組的使用者。
依群組成員資格篩選使用者

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Optional filter criteria to narrow down the user list based on specific attributes and conditions.

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: The maximum number of users to return in a single request. Default is 20, with pagination available for larger result sets.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 單一請求中要傳回的最大使用者數量。預設為 20，較大的結果集支援分頁。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Maximum number of users to return
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 返回的使用者最大數量

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: The pagination token to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous list operations.

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Retrieve a list of users from Active Directory
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 從 Active Directory 檢索使用者清單

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Get a paginated list of groups from Active Directory with optional filtering criteria. Useful for reporting and group management operations.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 從 Active Directory 取得群組的分頁清單，包含選填的篩選條件。適用於報表與群組管理作業。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Optional filter criteria to narrow down the group list based on specific attributes and conditions.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 可選的篩選條件，可根據特定屬性與條件縮小群組清單範圍。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: The maximum number of groups to return in a single request. Default is 20, with pagination available for larger result sets.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 單一請求中要傳回的最大群組數量。預設為 20，較大的結果集支援分頁。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Maximum number of groups to return
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 要傳回的最大群組數量

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: The pagination token to retrieve the next page of results. Obtained from previous list operations.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 用於檢索下一頁結果的分頁權杖。從先前列出的作業中取得。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Retrieve a list of groups from Active Directory
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 從 Active Directory 檢索群組清單

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source:
Make a custom HTTP / REST API call to **Active Directory** using the configured connection's authentication.

Specify the HTTP method, the URI path (relative to the connection's API base URL), optional query parameters, headers, and request body. The response is returned as a hash containing the status code, response headers, and response body.

Use this action for endpoints that are not yet exposed as first-class actions on this app.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message:
使用已設定連線的驗證向 **Active Directory** 發出自訂 HTTP / REST API 呼叫。

指定 HTTP 方法、URI 路徑（相對於連線的 API 基礎 URL）、選填查詢參數、標頭和請求主體。傳回的回應為包含狀態碼、回應標頭和回應主體的雜湊。

對於在此應用程式上尚未公開為主要動作的端點，請使用此動作。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: The request body. The effective type depends on `body_type`: JSON/form/YAML expect a hash, XML/text expect a string, multipart expects a file structure, binary expects raw bytes.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 請求主體。有效類型取決於 `body_type`：JSON/form/YAML 期望雜湊，XML/text 期望字串，multipart 期望檔案結構，binary 期望原始位元組。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Upload a file using `multipart/form-data`. The body must be a @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" structure (filename + content + mime_type). The framework builds the multipart envelope and sets the boundary header.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 使用 `multipart/form-data` 上傳檔案。主體必須是 @ref DataProvider::FileDataType "FileDataType" 結構（filename + content + mime_type）。架構會建立 multipart 封套並設定 boundary 標頭。
使用 multipart/form-data 上傳檔案

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Pass the body to the REST client unchanged; the client decides serialization based on its configured `data` option and the value type
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 原封不動地將主體傳遞給 REST 用戶端；用戶端會根據其設定的 `data` 選項和值類型來決定序列化方式

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Pass-through; use connection serialization and let the REST client decide
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 透傳；使用連線序列化並由 REST 用戶端決定

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Send the body as raw bytes. The body must be a binary value. Sets `Content-Type: application/octet-stream` unless overridden by `hdr`.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 將主體作為原始位元組傳送。主體必須是二進位值。除非被 `hdr` 覆蓋，否則會設定 `Content-Type: application/octet-stream`。
將主體作為原始位元組傳送

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Serialize a hash of form fields as `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`. The body must be a hash whose values are scalars (strings/numbers/booleans).
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 將表單欄位的雜湊序列化為 `application/x-www-form-urlencoded`。主體必須是值為純量（字串/數字/布林值）的雜湊。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Serialize body as application/x-www-form-urlencoded form fields
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 將主體序列化為 application/x-www-form-urlencoded 表單欄位

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Serialize the body as JSON; sets `Content-Type: application/json`. The body should be a hash, list, or scalar value.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 將主體序列化為 JSON；設定 `Content-Type: application/json`。主體應為雜湊、清單或純量值。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Send the body as plain text. The body must be a string. Sets `Content-Type: text/plain`.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 將主體作為純文字傳送。主體必須是字串。設定 `Content-Type: text/plain`。
將主體作為 text/plain 傳送

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Send the body as XML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to XML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/xml`.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 將主體作為 XML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 XML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/xml`。
將主體作為 XML 傳送

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Send the body as YAML. If the body is a hash it is serialized to YAML; if it is a string it is sent verbatim. Sets `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 將主體作為 YAML 傳送。若主體為雜湊，則會序列化為 YAML；若為字串，則原樣傳送。設定 `Content-Type: application/x-yaml`。
將主體作為 YAML 傳送

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Selects the body serialization mode and the corresponding `Content-Type` header. Changing this field reshapes the `body` editor - selecting JSON exposes a JSON editor, selecting Multipart Form exposes a file picker, and so on.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 選擇主體序列化模式及對應的 `Content-Type` 標頭。變更此欄位會重新配置 `body` 編輯器 — 選擇 JSON 會顯示 JSON 編輯器，選擇 Multipart 表單會顯示檔案選擇器，依此類推。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: How the body is serialized and what Content-Type is sent
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 主體如何序列化以及傳送何種 Content-Type

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: If `True`, non-2xx HTTP responses return as the normal response hash (with the actual status code) instead of raising `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`. Useful for handling 4xx/5xx as data - e.g. checking whether a resource exists. Overrides the connection's `error_passthru` setting for this call only.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 若為 `True`，非 2xx HTTP 回應會作為正常的相應雜湊傳回（帶有實際狀態碼），而非引發 `REST-RESPONSE-ERROR`。有助於將 4xx/5xx 作為資料處理 — 例如檢查資源是否存在。僅針對本次呼叫覆蓋連線的 `error_passthru` 設定。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Return non-2xx responses normally instead of throwing
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 正常傳回非 2xx 回應而非拋出例外

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Optional list of HTTP status codes treated as success. If set and the response status is not in this list, the action throws `REST-STATUS-ERROR`. When unset, the REST client's default behavior applies (typically: 2xx is success, non-2xx throws).
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 視為成功的 HTTP 狀態碼選擇性清單。若有設定且回應狀態不在此清單中，該動作會拋出 `REST-STATUS-ERROR`。若未設定，則套用 REST 用戶端的預設行為（通常：2xx 為成功，非 2xx 則拋出例外）。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Response status codes treated as success
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 視為成功的回應狀態碼

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Hash of custom headers added to the request. These override any default headers set by `body_type` (e.g. supplying `Content-Type` here wins over the body-type default).
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 新增至請求的自訂標頭雜湊。這些標頭會覆蓋由 `body_type` 設定的任何預設標頭（例如，在此處提供 `Content-Type` 會優先於主體類型的預設值）。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: If `True`, the response hash includes a `debug` sub-hash containing the request method/URL/headers (with sensitive values redacted), request and response sizes, and round-trip duration. Useful when investigating slow or failing calls. Off by default to keep responses lean.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 若為 `True`，回應雜湊包含 `debug` 子雜湊，其中含有請求方法/URL/標頭（敏感值已被隱藏）、請求與回應大小以及來回時間。在調查過慢或失敗的呼叫時很有用。預設為關閉以保持回應精簡。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Include request/timing/size debug info in the response
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 在回應中包含請求/計時/大小等除錯資訊

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: The HTTP method to use for the request
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 用於請求的 HTTP 方法

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL. May contain `{name}` placeholders that are replaced from `path_vars`. Example: `/users/{id}/comments`.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 相於連線 API 基底 URL 的 URI 路徑。可能包含從 `path_vars` 替換的 `{name}` 預留位置。範例：`/users/{id}/comments`。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: The URI path relative to the connection's API base URL
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 相對於連線 API 基礎 URL 的 URI 路徑

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Hash of values substituted into `{name}` placeholders in the URI path. Example: with `path = /users/{id}` and `path_vars = {id: 123}` the framework sends `/users/123`. Values are URL-encoded.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 代入 URI 路徑中 `{name}` 預留位置的值 Hash。範例：使用 `path = /users/{id}` 與 `path_vars = {id: 123}`，框架會傳送 `/users/123`。值均經過 URL 編碼。
路徑中 {name} 預留位置的值

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Hash of query string parameters to append to the URI path. Values are URL-encoded; list values are joined with `,`.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 要附加至 URI 路徑的查詢字串參數 Hash。值均經過 URL 編碼；清單值會以 `,` 連接。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Make a custom API call to Active Directory
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 向 Active Directory 發出自訂 API 呼叫

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Monitor Active Directory for newly created groups. This trigger can be filtered by specific criteria such as group type, visibility, or naming patterns to detect relevant group additions.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 監視 Active Directory 中的新建立群組。此觸發條件可依特定條件（例如群組類型、可見度或命名模式）進行篩選，以偵測相關的新增群組。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Optional filter criteria to specify which groups should trigger the event. Configure field, operator, and value to match specific group attributes.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 可選的篩選條件，用於指定哪些群組應觸發事件。設定欄位、運算子與值以比對特定的群組屬性。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Triggers when a new group is created in Active Directory
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 當在 Active Directory 中建立新群組時觸發

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Monitor Active Directory for newly created users. This trigger can be filtered by specific criteria such as user attributes, group membership, or organizational units to detect relevant user additions.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 監視 Active Directory 中的新建立使用者。此觸發條件可依特定條件（例如使用者屬性、群組成員資格或組織單位）進行篩選，以偵測相關的新增使用者。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Optional group identifier to monitor for new user additions. When specified, the trigger will only fire for users added to this particular group.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 用於監視新增使用者的可選群組識別碼。指定時，觸發條件僅會在使用者新增至此特定群組時觸發。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Monitor users added to a specific group
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 監視新增至特定群組的使用者

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Optional filter criteria to specify which users should trigger the event. Configure field, operator, and value to match specific user attributes.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 可選的篩選條件，用於指定哪些使用者應觸發事件。設定欄位、運算子與值以比對特定的使用者屬性。
使用者監視的篩選條件

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.source: Triggers when a new user is created in Active Directory
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.b.message: 當在 Active Directory 中建立新使用者時觸發

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.c.source: Remove a user from membership in an existing group in Active Directory. This revokes any permissions and access rights the user had through this group.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.c.message: 將使用者從 Active Directory 現有群組的成員資格中移除。這會撤銷使用者透過此群組擁有的所有權限與存取權。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.c.source: The unique identifier of the group to remove the user from. Select from existing groups in your directory.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.c.message: 要從中移除使用者的群組唯一識別碼。請從目錄中的現有群組選擇。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.c.source: The unique identifier of the user to be removed from the group. Select from existing users in your directory.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.c.message: 要從群組中移除的使用者唯一識別碼。請從目錄中的現有使用者選擇。

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.action.c.source: User to remove from the group

app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.desc.source: The Active Directory integration provides comprehensive actions and triggers to interact with Microsoft Graph API for user and group management. Automate user provisioning, group membership management, and organizational administration tasks with enterprise-grade security and compliance.
app.QXp1cmVBY3RpdmVEaXJlY3Rvcnk.desc.message: Active Directory 整合提供全方位的動作與觸發條件，以與 Microsoft Graph API 互動來進行使用者與群組管理。以企業級的安全性與合規性自動化使用者佈署、群組成員資格管理及組織管理工作。
